components.institution_label: Faculty Family and Medical Leave Policy
components.description: Family and medical leave of up to 12 weeks in a rolling 12-month period, designated as FMLA leave, for the faculty member's own serious health condition (including pregnancy and childbirth), the birth of a child and care for it, adoption or foster placement, or care of an ill spouse, child or parent; unpaid except for own-health leave (see c2); job-protected (return to the same position). May be taken intermittently or on a reduced-time basis for bonding only by agreement of the department and the faculty member.
components.mechanism_note: The handbook leave restates FMLA's 12 weeks without adding length and is designated FMLA leave, so it is coded as the statute (schema statute_source). Pay for own-health leave is c2/c3.
components.eligible_parent_wording: the faculty member’s own serious health condition, including pregnancy and childbirth-related conditions; the birth of the faculty member’s child and to care for that child; placement of a child with the faculty member for adoption or foster care; to care for a faculty member’s spouse
components.service_requirement: at least 12 months immediately preceding the commencement of the leave (reasons other than own serious health condition); none stated for own serious health condition
components.entitlement_note: 'Faculty may be granted a maximum of 12 weeks' reads as setting the maximum; the same passage speaks of the 'remaining leave entitlement', the Teaching section says faculty are 'entitled to family and medical leave', and the leave is designated FMLA (a statute: guaranteed). Read together (source precedence), guaranteed; flagged because V2's 'may be granted' wording alone would read discretionary.
components.duration_note: 12 weeks in any rolling 12-month period ('a maximum of'); time off beyond 12 weeks at the University's discretion is c5. Intermittent or reduced-time leave for bonding requires agreement of department and faculty member.
components.relief_note: no University duties are required during the period of the leave
components.medical_certification_note: certification from a health care provider for own serious health condition or care of a child, spouse or parent with a serious health condition
components.time_window: leave to care for a newborn or adopted/foster child must be completed within 12 months of the birth, adoption, or placement
components.notice: at least 30 days before the first date of the requested leave when possible; otherwise as soon as practicable
components.statute_source: Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993, 29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)

sequence.note: S1: FMLA-designated leave runs alongside the paid childbirth recovery leave from its start; own-health leave then bonding leave count against the same 12 weeks.
R3b: the discretionary teaching relief covers the portions of the semester not on leave, so it contains the leave.
